title: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title,
question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, and for the corresponding department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH fall_2022_subjects AS (
    SELECT
        so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        so.TERM_CODE,
        at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
        at.TERM_START_DATE
    FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
    WHERE at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2021-2022'
),
avg_year_by_term AS (
    SELECT
        ACADEMIC_YEAR,
        AVG(CAST(ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SIGNED)) AS avg_academic_year
    FROM fall_2022_subjects
    GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
department_stats AS (
    SELECT
        tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_enrolled,
        STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled
    FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM TIP_DETAIL td
          WHERE td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
      )
    GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
)
SELECT
    fss.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    fss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    fss.TERM_CODE,
    fss.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ayt.avg_academic_year,
    ds.variance_enrolled,
    ds.stddev_enrolled
FROM fall_2022_subjects fss
JOIN avg_year_by_term ayt ON fss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayt.ACADEMIC_YEAR
LEFT JOIN department_stats ds ON fss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY fss.TERM_START_DATE

ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.min_total_units_per_dept, NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, NULL AS OFFER_COUNT, '12-unit 2022 Degree-Granting Subject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS min_total_units_per_dept, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.offer_count, 'Top 3 Most Frequently Offered Mathematics Course' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COURSE_LEVEL, SCHOOL_NAME, min_total_units_per_dept, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_COUNT, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH student_info AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), student_info_with_admin AS (SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_info AS si LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), school_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_units) AS school_avg_units, VARIANCE(ic.avg_units) AS school_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE NOT d.SCHOOL_CODE IN (SELECT SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7') GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.school_avg_units, sus.school_units_variance FROM student_info_with_admin AS s LEFT JOIN school_units_stats AS sus ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = sus.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH DeptBudgetStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.dept_budget_code_stddev, d1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.avg_total_units, d2.range_total_units, d2.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM DeptBudgetStddev AS d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte1.subject_count, cte1.min_total_units, cte1.school_name, cte1.department_phone, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.dlc_key = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte2.area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), cte1 AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR), cte2 AS (SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.num_subjects, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.total_units_variance, cte2.total_units_stddev, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.num_subjects DESC, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.window_column

projection_contract.role: aggregation role: subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered

ordering role: term start date, and for the corresponding department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE), variance_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_stats), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), admin_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vs.enrolled_students_variance, vs.enrolled_students_stddev, vs.variance_category, ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ast.coefficient_of_variation, ast.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variance_stats AS vs JOIN admin_stats AS ast ON vs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY vs.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 Join: LEFT JOIN to department_stats ensures all Fall 2022 subjects are returned even if their department has no TIP data (though the question implies 'for the corresponding department', a LEFT JOIN is safer to avoid dropping subjects if the department stats are NULL, but given the specific phrasing 'for the corresponding department... variance', if a department has no TIP courses, the stats are undefined. However, since we are filtering TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED for the stats, if a department in SUBJECT_OFFERED has no corresponding TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED rows with TIP materials, the LEFT JOIN returns NULLs. This is standard behavior.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  s.TERM_CODE,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  AVG(CAST(t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SIGNED)) AS avg_academic_year,
  d.VARIANCE_ENROLL,
  d.STDDEV_ENROLL
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED s
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS VARIANCE_ENROLL,
    STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS STDDEV_ENROLL
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
    AND tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
      FROM TIP_DETAIL td
      WHERE td.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
    )
  GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
) d
  ON d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE

WITH fall_2022_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    cco.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE,
    cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    at.TERM_CODE,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.TERM_START_DATE
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON at.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  WHERE cco.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
    AND at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2022-2023'
),
avg_year_by_term AS (
  SELECT
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    AVG(CAST(ACADEMIC_YEAR AS DECIMAL(10,0))) AS avg_academic_year
  FROM fall_2022_subjects
  GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
  ORDER BY MIN(TERM_START_DATE)
),
department_stats AS (
  SELECT
    cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    VARIANCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_enrolled,
    STDDEV(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON at.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON so.SUBJECT_ID = cco.SUBJECT_ID AND so.TERM_CODE = cco.TERM_CODE
  WHERE cco.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
    AND at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2022-2023'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM TIP_DETAIL td
      JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
      WHERE td.TERM_CODE = cco.TERM_CODE
        AND td.SUBJECT_ID = cco.SUBJECT_ID
    )
  GROUP BY cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME
)
SELECT
  fss.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE,
  fss.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  fss.TERM_CODE,
  fss.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ayt.avg_academic_year,
  ds.variance_enrolled,
  ds.stddev_enrolled
FROM fall_2022_subjects fss
JOIN avg_year_by_term ayt ON fss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayt.ACADEMIC_YEAR
LEFT JOIN department_stats ds ON fss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY fss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fss.TERM_START_DATE, fss.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE
